images.alt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: vertical editorial gallery portrait for LT's Dailies. Scene/backdrop: a Vietnamese contemporary craft studio where thick indigo-dyed textile bands are woven through low rounded stone forms and hand-sewn into the earthen floor, creating a landscape that seems both soft and geological. Subject: one beautiful adult Vietnamese woman in her sixties, fully clothed in a pale silver high-neck long vest over an indigo shirt, wide gray trousers and soft closed shoes; lying in a composed side pose along one stone curve with her upper body raised on one forearm and her free hand resting flat on the textile. Style/medium: tactile fine-art editorial photography joining textile innovation, architecture and grounded craft, realistic mature skin, stitching, dye variation and stone grain. Composition/framing: vertical 2:3, complete body visible from an overhead oblique viewpoint, woven bands guide the eye through frame. Lighting/mood: diffuse workshop daylight with a single warm bounce, meditative and grounded. Color palette: indigo, pale silver, stone gray, earth brown and warm thread. Constraints: tasteful and nonsexual, adult, opaque modest clothing, anatomically plausible pose and hands, no text, logo, watermark, brand, celebrity likeness, or imitation of any living artist. Sewing Ground
